proposition.claim:
Every ergodic Gibbs u-state is either a center isometry or has a contracting full-cu-volume set contained in supp(mu).

Compact complex threefold; genuine product center fibration; stable multiplier (3-sqrt(5))/2<1/2 and unstable multiplier (3+sqrt(5))/2>2; spherical center derivative between 1/2 and 2; Haar base mixing and Gibbs u condition verified.

The displayed F is an automorphism of the Lie algebra with [e1,e2]=[e3,e4]=e5.

The exponential of the integer span of the stipulated Heisenberg basis is a lattice subgroup.

W=L^(direct sum 2n), but degree(det W)=n degree(L).

repair.content:
Remove B subset supp(mu), or allow B in the center saturation of supp(mu). Lemma 3.7 constructs such a larger set; Section 4 uses its full-volume property, not the invalid support restriction.

A different type-(1,1) bracket with Q=[[-2,1],[1,2]], A^TQA=Q, determinant -5 yields an integrable J and valid F. Retain a BCH-closed half-central lattice and consistent left-quotient convention; stable/unstable brackets generate one real central dimension, giving five-dimensional accessibility.

Use half Gaussian integers in the complex central coordinate, integral horizontal coordinates; BCH and the integral determinant-one automorphism preserve this subgroup in both directions.

Replace n by 2n.
